caption_used: Mean absolute values of hidden states across model layers, comparing pre-gating, post-gating, and baseline configurations. The hidden state mean before gate (blue dashed line, avg 0.71) remains near zero through approximately layer 15, then rises sharply to a peak of roughly 2.8 at layer 23. The post-gating hidden state mean (orange dotted, avg 0.05) and baseline mean (green solid, avg 0.04) both remain close to zero throughout, with the baseline showing marginally higher values than the post-gating mean in the final layers. The dramatic pre-gating increase beginning at layer 12 demonstrates that gating effectively suppresses the activation amplification observed in deeper layers.

raw_responses.Bulgarian:
DESCRIPTION: Тази фигура илюстрира промените в средните абсолютни стойности на скритите състояния (hidden states) през различните слоеве на модел, като сравнява три конфигурации. Заглавието на графиката е "Hidden State Mean". Оста X е обозначена като "Layer" и използва линейна скала с диапазон от 0 до приблизително 23, като етикетите са разположени през интервали от 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Оста Y е обозначена като "Abs Mean" и също използва линейна скала с диапазон от 0 до приблизително 4.5, като етикетите са разположени през интервали от 0.5 или 1.0 (0, 1, 2, 3, 4).

Първата линия е синя и пунктирана (dashed), обозначена в легендата като "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71". Тя започва от стойност близо до 0 при слой 0, леко се повишава до около 0.2–0.3 в диапазона от слой 2 до слой 7, след което леко спада и остава около 0.2 до слой 10. От слой 10 до слой 12 стойността нараства до приблизително 0.4–0.5, а от слой 15 нататък се наблюдава рязко нарастване — стойността достига около 0.9 при слой 18, след което продължава стръмно нагоре до приблизително 2.6 при слой 21 и завършва с лек спад до около 2.5 при слой 23.

Втората линия е оранжева и точкувана (dotted), обозначена като "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05". Тя остава много близо до 0 през целия диапазон на слоевете, от слой 0 до слой 23, без видими значителни отклонения.

Третата линия е зелена и плътна (solid), обозначена като "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04". Тя също остава много близо до 0 през целия диапазон, като в последните слоеве (приблизително от слой 20 до слой 23) показва минимално повишение до стойности около 0.05–0.1, което е едва забележимо визуално.
raw_responses.Chinese:
This figure, titled "Hidden State Mean," displays the absolute mean values of hidden states across model layers for three configurations: before gating, after gating, and a baseline. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 4.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. Three data series are plotted. The first is a blue dashed line representing "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71," which starts near 0 at layer 0, rises slightly to around 0.2–0.3 in the range of layers 2 through 7, dips back toward approximately 0.1 around layers 9–10, then gradually increases through layers 10–15 reaching roughly 0.4–0.5, and subsequently rises steeply from around layer 17 onward, reaching approximately 2.6 at layer 22 before climbing to roughly 2.6–2.8 near layer 23. The second is an orange dotted line representing "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05," which remains very close to zero throughout all layers, staying below approximately 0.1 across the entire range. The third is a green solid line representing "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04," which also remains very close to zero throughout all layers, with values slightly increasing in the final layers to approximately 0.1 near layer 23, appearing marginally above the orange dotted line in those later layers.

raw_responses.English: DESCRIPTION: This plot illustrates the mean absolute values of hidden states across model layers, comparing three configurations: pre-gating, post-gating, and baseline. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and spans a linear scale from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and spans a linear scale from 0 to approximately 4.5, with tick marks at intervals of 1. Three data series are shown. The first is a blue dashed line representing "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71," which starts near 0 at layer 0, remains relatively low (around 0.1–0.3) through approximately layer 10, then begins a gradual increase reaching roughly 0.5 around layer 15, followed by a steep rise through layers 18–23, reaching a peak value of approximately 2.6 at layer 23. The second is an orange dotted line representing "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05," which remains very close to zero throughout all layers, with only a slight increase visible in the final layers to approximately 0.05–0.1. The third is a green solid line representing "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04," which also remains very close to zero across all layers, showing a marginal increase in the later layers to roughly 0.1 by layer 23. Both the orange and green lines are nearly overlapping and stay close to the x-axis for the entirety of the plot, while the blue dashed line diverges dramatically upward in the deeper layers.
raw_responses.German: DESCRIPTION: Dieses Diagramm trägt den Titel „Hidden State Mean" und zeigt die absoluten Mittelwerte der Hidden States über die Modellschichten hinweg für drei verschiedene Konfigurationen. Die x-Achse ist mit „Layer" beschriftet und erstreckt sich auf einer linearen Skala von 0 bis etwa 23, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Die y-Achse ist mit „Abs Mean" beschriftet und reicht auf einer linearen Skala von 0 bis etwa 4,5, mit Tick-Beschriftungen bei 0, 1, 2, 3 und 4. Die erste Linie, dargestellt als blaue gestrichelte Linie, repräsentiert den „hidden state mean before gate" mit einem angegebenen Durchschnitt von 0,71. Diese Linie beginnt bei Layer 0 nahe 0, steigt leicht auf etwa 0,2 bis 0,3 im Bereich von Layer 3 bis 7, fällt dann leicht zurück auf etwa 0,1 bei Layer 10, bevor sie ab Layer 12 einen deutlichen Anstieg zeigt. Ab Layer 15 steigt sie steil an, erreicht bei Layer 18 etwa 0,5, bei Layer 20 etwa 0,9, und steigt dann drastisch auf einen Spitzenwert von ungefähr 2,6 bei Layer 22 und weiter auf etwa 2,8 bei Layer 23, wobei ein kurzer Rückgang zwischen Layer 21 und 22 sichtbar ist. Die zweite Linie, dargestellt als orange gepunktete Linie, repräsentiert den „hidden state mean after gate" mit einem angegebenen Durchschnitt von 0,05. Diese Linie verläuft über alle Schichten hinweg nahe bei null und zeigt nur minimale Schwankungen, wobei sie am Ende bei Layer 23 einen Wert von etwa 0,05 bis 0,1 erreicht. Die dritte Linie, dargestellt als grüne durchgezogene Linie, repräsentiert den „hidden state mean of baseline" mit einem angegebenen Durchschnitt von 0,04. Auch diese Linie bleibt über den gesamten Verlauf nahe null, mit einem leichten Anstieg in den letzten Schichten auf etwa 0,1 bei Layer 23.
